count_q.instructions: How many red ovals are in `photo`? Count an oval that is cut off by the edge of `photo` too. The blue squares are not ovals.

criteria.none: No red oval, not even part of one.
criteria.one: Exactly one red oval, whole or cut off by the edge.
criteria.several: Two or more red ovals, whole or cut off by the edge.

box_q.instructions: the red oval in `photo` (only its visible part)
